typed_links.link: The kevod-YHWH notice followed by a fresh divine-speech formula recurs at 14:10, 16:19, WEB 16:42-43, and 20:6; one seam rule now applies at all four sites.

Uniform-content registers are kept whole (ch 1 census, ch 7 prince register) while content-differentiated entries stand alone; the ch 26 census merges applied the same criterion. Per-entry parashah counterevidence is restated in the frozen rationale at M8-Num-183 and preserved in the underlying review trail for the other merged entries.
The standalone summary/statute colophons (2:32-34 precedent, 10:28, 35:29) receive one treatment; the 35:29|30 split aligned the third site.
